hypothesis.statement: Across 50 subjects, center-of-pressure path length during quiet standing is greater on a foam surface than on a firm surface (paired difference > 0); the newly-authored pairedTTest reproduces scipy.stats.ttest_rel AND base R t.test(paired=TRUE) BIT-FOR-BIT.

analysis_plan.dataset: Santos & Duarte (2016) balance dataset (figshare); COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) on eyes-open foam vs eyes-open firm surface for 50 subjects

decision.threshold: descriptive: pairedTTest equals scipy.stats.ttest_rel and base R t.test to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); foam sway exceeds firm sway (t > 0, p < 0.001)
